description: Decommissioned Indian Navy Sea Harrier, formerly embarked on INS Viraat, transported to Bandra in March 2020, installed on a traffic island at Bandstand in May 2020 and formally handed to the city 3 Dec 2020 (Indian Express, Bandra Buzz, The Hindu). Still referred to as the naval aircraft at Bandstand in a May 2026 Mid-Day report. Serial not published - blank; needs reading on site. Coordinates approximate (Bandstand).
museum_name: Bandstand Promenade Bandra Mumbai Sea Harrier
